topbar_search_desc: Quickly find users, nodes, or settings across the entire ecosystem.

copy_desc: Quickly copy the current view to your clipboard for sharing.
export_desc: Download the complete dataset in your preferred format (CSV, Excel).

scope_desc: Filter telemetry strictly from Central Command or specific Tenant Nodes.
time_desc: Quickly jump to specific timeframes or set custom date boundaries to hunt for events.
vault_desc: Configure automated retention policies or manually trigger a cold storage sweep.
deep_search_desc: Search the ledger instantly by operator name, description, or module.
